title: catpart-fitness run report, schema v0
description: Full report of one catpart-fitness run (ADR-0001: a report per run, kept next to the committed history). It is the audit trail behind the appended history row: per-file classifications, per-split aggregates and the no-regret verdict. Classification vocabulary follows ticket #14 and the Clean parse definition in GLOSSARY.md: clean, schema-invalid (validated against the committed catpart-inspect schema - v1 as of ticket #23), crash (catpart-inspect raised, including the documented file-level refusals), missing-invariant (output valid but a minimal invariant fails), plus unavailable for manifest rows whose file is not on disk (never parsed, counts against the rate denominator). Evolution is additive within a schema version: consumers must ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bumped only by a breaking change of the report shape; additive changes keep the version.

inspect_schema_version.description: Version of the catpart-inspect output schema the run validated every parsed file against (1 as of ticket #23); additive field (Spec C: the schema version is part of every output document and every history row). Reports emitted before ticket #23 lack the field.

run_id.description: Run identifier: UTC timestamp (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ) plus six hex characters, unique per run.

timestamp.description: UTC wall-clock instant of the run, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

tool_version.description: catpart-parser package version that produced the report.

manifest_path.description: Corpus manifest path exactly as passed to the runner (typically relative to the repository root).

corpus_digest.description: SHA-256 of the corpus manifest file bytes (the corpus registry, per-file digests included).

splits.description: Per-split aggregates keyed by the manifest's split values (dev, held-out — the ADR-0001 author-grouped split, encoded in the manifest's split column).

files.description: Manifest rows in this split; the rate denominator.

available.description: Rows whose file exists on disk and was classified.

unavailable.description: Rows whose file is not on disk; counted as not clean.

totals.description: Same counters summed over all splits (no rate: the headline is per split).

scalars.description: Per-level scalars (ADR-0001 keeps room for L1/L2/L3); L2/L3 are null until those levels exist.

accepted.description: Verdict of the run under the no-regret rule (ADR-0001).

baseline_run_id.description: run_id of the last accepted row compared against, or null when there is no baseline.

files.description: One record per manifest row, in manifest order. Files are identified by their manifest SHA-256; the committed manifest joins sha256 to repo, source_url and the rest.

path.description: The manifest's path column (repository-relative path of the file).

detected_version.description: CNEXTINFOS version from the catpart-inspect output; null when the file was never parsed (unavailable).

container_names.description: Container names at container level: the parsed container-name table records (schema v1), unique, in first-occurrence order; null when the file was never parsed. Reports from the v0 era carried the whole-file vocabulary scan instead.

kind.description: Part/product kind from the catpart-inspect output (law K1); null when the file was never parsed.

error.description: Failure detail: the exception type and message for crash, the validator message for schema-invalid, the invariant failure for missing-invariant, the missing path for unavailable; null for clean.
